source_refs.note: Exercise 8.4, Question 2 (book p. 253); answer key p. 307 (PDF 309).

blocks.prompt: 2. The flow rate of blood in an artery is modeled by the nonlinear equation \(Q = k\left(P - \frac{Q^{2}}{R}\right)\), where \(Q\) is the flow rate (mL/s), \(P = 100\) mmHg is the blood pressure, \(k = 0.05\), and \(R = 10\). Determine the possible real values of the flow rate \(Q\) accurate to two decimal places.
blocks.explanation:
Constants rakhne ke baad yeh model Q ki ek quadratic equation ban jata hai, jis ke do real roots hain.
Diya kya hai? Model aur teen constants P, k, R. Find kya karna hai? Q ki saari real values, do decimal places tak.
Method sawal mein nahin likha, is liye hum Newton-Raphson lenge kyun ke f' bohat aasaan hai aur yeh sab se tez hai.
Plan: f(Q) = 0 banana, sign change se har root ki jagah dhoondna, iterations chalana, aur aakhir mein dekhna ke kaunsi value asal mein flow rate ho sakti hai.
Tasdeeq quadratic formula se karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(Q = k(P - Q^{2}/R)\), \(P = 100\), \(k = 0.05\), \(R = 10\).
Maloom karna: \(Q\) ki real values, do decimal places tak.
Tareeqa: Newton-Raphson \(Q_{n+1} = Q_n - f(Q_n)/f'(Q_n)\). Kyun? Kyun ke f ek seedhi si polynomial banegi jis ka derivative ek line mein nikal aata hai.

Equation banaiye
\[Q = 0.05\left(100 - \dfrac{Q^{2}}{10}\right)\]
\[Q = 5 - 0.005Q^{2}\]
\[f(Q) = 0.005Q^{2} + Q - 5 = 0\]
\[f'(Q) = 0.01Q + 1\]
Kyun: 0.05 ko bracket ke andar multiply kiya: \(0.05 \times 100 = 5\) aur \(0.05 \times Q^{2}/10 = 0.005Q^{2}\). Phir sab ek taraf le aaye, kyun ke Newton-Raphson ko \(f(Q) = 0\) chahiye. Polynomial hai, is liye continuous bhi aur differentiable bhi.

Positive root kahan hai?
\[f(4) = 0.08 + 4 - 5 = -0.92 < 0\]
\[f(5) = 0.125 + 5 - 5 = 0.125 > 0\]
Root \([4, 5]\) mein; \(Q_0 = 5\) lete hain.
Kyun: \(f(5) = 0.125\), \(f(4) = -0.92\) ke muqable mein zero ke bohat qareeb hai, aur \(f'(5) = 1.05 \ne 0\), to formula lag sakta hai.

Iteration 1
\[Q_1 = 5 - \dfrac{0.125}{1.05}\]
\[= 5 - 0.1190 = 4.8810\]
Kyun: Newton-Raphson formula mein Q_0 = 5 rakha. f(5) positive tha, is liye qadam left ki taraf gaya.

Doosra real root
\[f(-204) = 208.08 - 209 = -0.92\]
\[f(-205) = 210.125 - 210 = 0.125\]
\(Q_0 = -205\) se shuru, \(f'(-205) = -1.05\):
\[Q_1 = -205 - \dfrac{0.125}{-1.05} = -204.8810\]
\[Q_2 = -204.8809\]
Kyun: \(f(Q) = 0\) ko 200 se multiply karein to \(Q^{2} + 200Q - 1000 = 0\) banta hai. Quadratic ke roots ka jama \(-b/a = -200\) hota hai, is liye doosra root \(-200 - 4.88\) ke qareeb hona chahiye. Isi liye hum ne \(-204\) aur \(-205\) check kiye.
Dhyan dein: sawal 'possible real values' (jama) keh raha hai, is liye doosra root dhoondna bhi zaroori hai.

Kaunsi value mumkin hai?
\(Q \approx -204.88\) ka matlab hoga ke khoon pressure ke khilaaf ulti taraf beh raha hai, jo is model mein be-maani hai. Is liye yeh rad.
Kyun: mathematics kabhi kabhi aise roots bhi deti hai jo asal situation par fit nahin hote; unhein pehchaan kar chhorna samajhdari hai.

Tasdeeq
\[Q^{2} + 200Q - 1000 = 0\]
\[Q = -100 \pm \sqrt{11000}\]
\[= -100 \pm 104.8809\]
Yani \(Q = 4.8809\) ya \(Q = -204.8809\). Sign test: \(f(4.875) = -0.0062 < 0\), \(f(4.885) = 0.0043 > 0\), is liye do places par 4.88 bilkul sahi.
Kyun: quadratic formula exact roots deta hai aur dono iterations ki tasdeeq karta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Real values \(Q \approx 4.88\) aur \(Q \approx -204.88\) hain; sirf \(Q \approx 4.88\) mL/s mumkin flow rate hai.
